help.title: How the payment schedule is calculated

items: The supplier debt is their settlements balance (all movements: payments, returns, adjustments), not the sum of orders.

blocks.title: Spreading by dates
items: The debt is spread over unpaid received orders from the oldest payment date; orders the debt does not reach count as paid.
